test_ConfusionMatrix: test the ConfusionMatrix metric class for multiclass classification with optional label weights and background class exclusion
test_ConfusionMatrix3D: test the ConfusionMatrix3D metric class for temporal segmentation tasks with mask and label weights support
test_MIou: test the MIoU metric class for mean intersection over union computation with background class exclusion
test_macro_metrics: test the F1Macro, PrecisionMacro, and RecallMacro metric classes for macro-averaged classification evaluation
test_stratified_avg_metric: test the get_stratified_avg_metric factory function for creating stratified MAE and Pearson correlation metrics
